title: A Birthday Party
text:
Maria wants to have a party. She writes an invitation for her friend Ana. The party is on Saturday at four o'clock. It is at Maria's house.

Ana says yes. She wants to bring a cake for Maria. At the party, they play games and dance. Ana is very happy.

questions.text: What does Ana want to bring?
Why is Ana happy at the end of the text?
options: She enjoys the party with her friends
She has to clean the house

questions.text: What kind of person is Maria?
options: A friendly person who likes to share time with friends
A person who does not like parties
A person who lives in another city

vocabulary.definition: a social event where people meet to eat, talk and have fun
a card or message asking someone to come to an event
a sweet food made from flour, eggs and sugar, often served at parties
activities that people play for fun

paragraph_translations: Maria quer dar uma festa. Ela escreve um convite para sua amiga Ana. A festa é no sábado às quatro horas. A festa é na casa da Maria.
Ana diz que sim. Ela quer levar um bolo para a Maria. Na festa, eles brincam de jogos e dançam. Ana está muito feliz.
